notes.title: 📸《Photo Studio Simulator》Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear players, thank you for your continued support and feedback! In this update, we've made numerous optimizations and fixes to the gameplay and performance, hoping to provide a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.

🆕 Update Content
Fixed an issue with models appearing repeatedly in the bar at night.

Fixed a bug where delivery items could be sent to the dating scene.

Optimized overall game performance, improving game fluidity and frame rate.

Optimized customer behavior, resetting some situations to a running state for a more engaging gameplay pacing.

Optimized the expressions of some NPC customers for a more natural feel.

Optimized the default outfit of model Feiyin and added textures.

Optimized model Nia's skin tone.

Added categorized display for photography prop boxes for clearer prop management.

Added a photo paper recycling feature to streamline inventory management.


Thanks for your feedback! If you encounter issues or have suggestions, please leave a message in the community or join the discussion. Your support is our driving force. ❤️

notes.title: Photo Studio Simulator Update Log
notes.notes:
This update primarily addresses some functional anomalies and user experience issues, improving overall game stability and playability.

Update Content

🛠️Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where objects would get stuck in your hand when placing them on a robot.

Fixed an issue where a baseball bat would get lost when a thief steals something.

Fixed an issue where the model's clothing would be incorrectly displayed after taking multiple private photos.

Fixed an issue where package photos would turn white after saving them with a value of 0.


👨‍🎨Optimization Adjustments
The daily limit for scratch-off lottery tickets has been adjusted to 20–40, improving the player experience.


🐞Functionality and Security
To strengthen anti-piracy measures and protect the experience and rights of legitimate players, all players will only be able to play the game for 7 days when Steam is offline.

notes.title: Latest Patch Released: Bug Fixes & Game Improvements
notes.notes:
First, we would like to offer our sincere apologies to all players who have encountered issues during the game. Thank you for your patience and understanding — we truly value every piece of feedback and have acted promptly to fix and improve the game.



Bug Fixes:
📸 Fixed an issue where photos appeared white. Due to system permission restrictions on some PCs, photos could not be saved. A compatibility option has now been added in the Settings menu for affected players.
💰 Starting funds of $2000 are now automatically granted when reading the initial letter — no need to pick them up manually.
👗 The model's default outfit is now included in the outfit list. You can switch to other outfits and still return to the default outfit.



Updates & Improvements:
🖥️ Added ultrawide and 4K resolution options.
🎯 Added a toggle for motion blur in Settings.
⚡ V-Sync will no longer cap the framerate at 60 FPS.
💬 Added help prompts for intimate conversations.
🖱️ Self-service kiosk prompts are now more obvious, with directional text hints.
📍 Added waypoint indicators for placement locations in self-service kiosk tasks, making it easier to find exact spots.
📍 Added waypoint indicators for frames produced by the 3D printer, making placement clearer.
🕵️‍♂️ Adjusted thief spawn rates: 3% when the power is on (previously 10%), 20% when the power is out (previously 60%).
🎁 Increased the affection points given by general gifts:

Bouquet: 2 → 4

Flower: 3 → 6

Aroma: 4 → 8

Chocolate: 5 → 10

Premium Perfume: 6 → 12



This update not only fixes key bugs but also improves visuals and gameplay features, providing a smoother and more convenient photography experience. Update now to enjoy the full improvements!

notes.title: Photo Studio Simulator Update Log V0.5
notes.notes:
Dear photo buddy,

We are excited to announce that Photo Studio Simulator  has reached a significant milestone with the release of Beta Version 0.5! In this update, we’ve introduced a brand-new feature aimed at helping you get started effortlessly before opening your full-fledged photography studio, allowing you to enjoy the thrill of managing your business.

📌 Street Photo Booths: Your First Step to Success

Have you ever felt overwhelmed, unsure of where to begin? Worry no more, because we’ve got you covered with an exciting new feature – Street Photo Booths. This simple and user-friendly equipment is your first step toward building a successful photography studio. The photo booths come in three levels, each catering to different customer needs. All you have to do is perform basic maintenance and adjustments, then sit back and watch the money roll in!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118290/3b49d16d9eeb4e6da10ffb29ce64dc7efade0c64.png

📌 Progressing from Simple to Professional

We understand that every new shop owner might feel a bit anxious about the complexity of managing a business at the start. That’s why we designed these photo booths to let you experience the satisfaction of seeing customers flock to your booth without requiring too much intervention. As you gain more experience, you’ll unlock more advanced equipment, each upgrade representing your journey from a small street booth to a professional photography business!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118290/253b343e3ebdf877fce03dd308fe8ab7301a4180.png

📌 Real-Time Display: Keep Your Business Under Control

In this update, we’ve also added a real-time display feature to the photo booths. This means that whenever a customer takes a photo, you can directly view the process and results on the screen. This feature makes it easier for you to monitor and maintain your equipment while ensuring every transaction runs smoothly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118290/978d16bad1f99a8545d80560d00c200f59c3d98b.png

📌Easy to Start, Endless Fun

Through this update, we hope to make Photo Simulator accessible and enjoyable for more players. Here, you don’t need to worry about complex operations or high startup costs. With just a bit of effort, you can gradually build your photography empire in this virtual world.

We eagerly await your feedback on this update. We hope these new features bring you more joy and satisfaction, and we look forward to having you continue with us on this journey as Photo Studio Simulator  grows!

Sincerely,
JesseMJ, Indie Game Developer
